scope: Fictional local-storage and server simulation; no private runtime/security/hosted/physical proof
browserPath: Browser plugin not available; regular isolated Playwright QA

checks.name: Page identity, meaningful 18-player roster and explicit fictional/security boundaries
Unsaved choices are distinct from durable work; dirty navigation and Escape preserve choices/focus
Real IndexedDB abort rolls back both intent and local projection; choices remain unsaved
Network-disabled local save commits exact packet, original ID, base versions and projection together; zero simulated server writes
Actual browser process restart retains the same complete original save, not a new operation
Reconnect confirms the whole selected batch; unselected stays Unmarked; saved marks use existing corrections
One competing player mark refuses the entire batch and retains Base/Local/Current comparison
Changed roster version blocks upload, preserving the immutable original packet
Withdrawn publication blocks the whole upload without removing local work
Real receipt transaction abort retains local intent/projection; original receipt recovers one server effect
Future device timestamp cannot extend the existing server recording deadline
Committed reply loss blocks replacements; reload reconciles the original receipt with one effect
No-receipt unknown upload retries exact original ID and bytes, without generating a replacement
Mismatched receipt never confirms local work; exact original outcome recovers without another effect
Logout removes replicas but retains pending identity; foreign account cannot open/send; original account recovers
checks.security: UI/scope simulation only; fictional unencrypted DB is not confidentiality proof

checks.name: Explicit simulated 30-day cleanup preserves pending work separately; recovered original can synchronize
Known denial hides rows, stops upload and survives reload; same-account login cannot restore access
Two tabs reconnect using a per-scope Web Lock and idempotent receipt; one recorded batch
Quiet cross-tab capture/confirmation retains dirty input; stale choices cannot overwrite the saved mark
Complete 18-player register saves all 17 new marks together and preserves the existing saved mark
24 EN/AR dark/light viewport combinations fit 320–1440px; labelled targets, RTL and native-dialog focus return
200%-equivalent 1440px reflow leaves register usable without page horizontal scrolling
checks.limit: Viewport equivalent only; physical browser zoom and mobile keyboard not claimed

checks.name: No app console errors, framework overlay, external asset/API requests or swallowed UI errors

limitations: Unencrypted fictional IndexedDB, simulated accounts and server
No Clerk/API/SQL/provider traffic or security confidentiality proof
No service worker, offline cold launch or closed-app background guarantee
No production or privileged access change
